extractions.value: Patient had congenital first-degree AV block and tricuspid regurgitation. Invitae primary immunodeficiency panel (407 genes) revealed several heterozygous variants of unknown significance (VUS) in C2, CIITA, NLRP12, SAMD9L, and SRP72 genes. Parental study and whole exome sequencing (WES) were recommended.
